Military Tier guides: MT0–15

Choose your current tier. Learn what matters now, why it matters, and how to prepare for the next promotion.

How these guides work

Every stage includes a goal, short definitions, an ordered route, troubleshooting and a readiness checklist. Sources are linked next to the advice and summarized at the bottom of each page. You do not need to read the late-game guides to understand an early-game step.

Military Tier is your overall progression stage. Module tier and module level describe individual upgrades. Headquarters may ask for a collection count, maximized modules, total module tier, a combat milestone or several of these at once. Check each objective separately.

Requirements changed after v1.0. The supplied research flags outdated total-module-tier targets, the MT5 change to 80 maximized modules and removal of the old MT6 boss requirement. Current Headquarters requirements take precedence over historical tables. [S01] [S02]

Infinity progression

Using older advice responsibly

These guides adapt the supplied walkthrough and source appendix. They explain the reasoning behind a route without presenting old timings, imported builds or numerical thresholds as guaranteed current solutions. Exact blueprint and script import codes are outside this series; the linked community collections provide further material to inspect.
